rows.title: Mac Setup and Project Tooling Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Create, rename, run, and archive notes for a blank SwiftUI app without changing signing or distribution settings.

rows.title: Mac Setup and Project Tooling Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Compare two destinations and write a short troubleshooting decision tree for a preview success paired with a simulator failure.

rows.title: Xcode Project Anatomy Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Annotate the supplied project diagram and make one asset-backed visual change in the first app.

rows.title: Xcode Project Anatomy Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Repair a target-membership or asset-name mismatch and preserve a before-and-after explanation of the evidence used.

rows.title: SwiftUI Mental Model Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Complete the canonical SAD1 Welcome Profile App with a coherent visual hierarchy and one reusable profile component.

rows.title: SwiftUI Mental Model Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add an alternate profile state, adaptive layout, and a documented modifier-order experiment without introducing navigation or shared data early.

rows.title: Swift Basics in App Context Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Replace literal profile content with typed model values and render a supplied list with an explicit empty state.

rows.title: Swift Basics in App Context Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add filtering, sorting, and optional metadata while keeping model transformations outside deeply nested view markup.

rows.title: Functions, Structs, and Enums Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Refactor profile data into a small model, function, and display-state enum while preserving the same visible behavior.

rows.title: Functions, Structs, and Enums Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add validation and model-only tests, then explain where value semantics reduce accidental shared mutation.

rows.title: What an App Is Structurally Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Turn the first app into a readable multi-file structure with a model, reusable view, and documented startup path.

rows.title: What an App Is Structurally Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Compare two feature-boundary options and defend the simpler one with change and testing scenarios.

rows.title: State and Data Flow Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Add a favorite toggle and editable note with explicit ownership, binding, and a visible reset path.

rows.title: State and Data Flow Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Move related shared state into an observable model, add a transition test, and document the compatibility route for an older deployment target.

rows.title: Media, Maps, and Device Features Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Complete the canonical SAD2 Media Gallery and SAD4 Map Places apps using supplied nonpersonal assets and coordinates.

rows.title: Media, Maps, and Device Features Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Design and test a permission-aware enhancement with denied, restricted, unavailable, and no-network states while preserving the static fallback.

rows.title: Navigation and Multi Screen Apps Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Complete the canonical SAD3 Multi-Tab Hobby App with peer tabs, one drill-down detail, and one focused editor or information sheet.

rows.title: Navigation and Multi Screen Apps Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add route restoration or typed navigation data and verify each path from cold launch, tab switch, and cancellation.

rows.title: Lists, Forms, and CRUD Patterns Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Complete the in-memory canonical SAD5 Simple Tracker with add, edit, toggle, delete, validation, and empty-state behavior.

rows.title: Lists, Forms, and CRUD Patterns Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add deterministic filtering, duplicate policy, and a reversible destructive-action path with focused model tests.

rows.title: Persistence Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Persist the canonical SAD5 Simple Tracker locally and prove its core records survive a controlled relaunch.

rows.title: Persistence Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add an in-memory test container, one schema-evolution note, and a safe reset or export route for sample data.

rows.title: Networking and Data Loading Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Complete the canonical SAD6 API Reference App with a local fixture, explicit state model, decode validation, and recoverable error view.

rows.title: Networking and Data Loading Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add a protocol-backed client, injected failure fixtures, cancellation, and a cache decision without storing sensitive data.

rows.title: Debugging and Testing Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Repair one supplied tracker or network-state defect and add a Swift Testing regression that fails before the correction and passes after it.

rows.title: Debugging and Testing Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add parameterized and asynchronous cases, then explain what remains for simulator or UI-level validation.

rows.title: App Design and Accessibility Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Audit and improve the Welcome Profile, Tracker, or API app with a recorded large-text and screen-reader pass.

rows.title: App Design and Accessibility Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Test additional accessibility settings, prioritize unresolved barriers, and explain one design tradeoff without claiming universal compliance.

rows.title: Running on Simulator and Device Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Execute and record a repeatable simulator smoke test for the current strongest app.

rows.title: Running on Simulator and Device Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Compare a personally controlled device with the simulator and diagnose one evidence-backed difference without collecting device identifiers in the submission.

rows.title: Apple Developer Ecosystem Overview Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add individual and organization role branches and a classroom simulation that requires no shared credentials.

rows.title: Certificates, Signing, and Bundle IDs Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Annotate a signing relationship map and resolve three supplied configuration cases without touching a real distribution account.

rows.title: Certificates, Signing, and Bundle IDs Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add entitlement and role constraints to the matrix and explain which account role is authorized to perform the action.
rows.originalTaskText: Add entitlement and role constraints to the matrix and explain when an instructor or account holder must perform the action.

rows.title: App Store Connect and TestFlight Workflow Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Prepare a simulated TestFlight release packet with beta description, test focus, build record, group choice, and feedback triage.

rows.title: App Store Connect and TestFlight Workflow Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Compare internal and external routes, add one review or export-compliance blocker, and revise the release packet after supplied feedback.

rows.title: Capstone App Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Complete the canonical SAD7 Publish-Ready Capstone as a tested release candidate with a scoped primary flow and evidence packet.

rows.title: Capstone App Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add one architecturally justified feature, automated boundary test, and evidence-backed revision without expanding beyond the stated release scope.

rows.title: Final Publishing Walkthrough Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Prepare and audit the capstone's simulated submission packet, then make a documented submit or hold decision.

rows.title: Final Publishing Walkthrough Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Respond to a supplied review rejection or privacy change and revise the packet, build plan, and release decision.

rows.title: SADX Enrichment and Reference Boundaries Transfer Practice
rows.taskText: Complete one adaptive custom Shape and a short modern-versus-legacy transfer note.

rows.title: SADX Enrichment and Reference Boundaries Extension Practice
rows.taskText: Add animatable data and reduced-motion behavior, then verify geometry across three frame shapes.
